task_description: Write a method in Dafny to return the negative numbers from an integer array.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method FindNegatives(arr: array<int>) returns (negatives: array<int>)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - All elements in the output array are negative numbers
    - Every negative number in the input array appears in the output array
    - The order of negative numbers in the output array is the same as their order in the input array
code_response:
Step 1: Determine the method’s signature.
In this case:
    method FindNegativeNumbers(arr: array<int>) returns (negatives: seq<int>)

Step 2: Determine the preconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:

Dafny specification:
    requires arr != null

Step 3: Determine the postconditions.
In this case:
Natural language description:
    - The output sequence contains exactly those elements from the input array that are negative
    - All elements in the output sequence are negative
    - The order of elements in the output sequence is the same as their order in the input array

Dafny specification:
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |negatives| ==> IsNegative(negatives[i])
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < arr.Length && IsNegative(arr[i]) ==> exists k :: 0 <= k < |negatives| && negatives[k] == arr[i]
    ensures multiset(negatives) == multiset([a | a in arr[..] | IsNegative(a)])

Step 4: Write the code, its formal specification, and the verification annotations that help the solver prove the postconditions.
In this case:

```dafny
predicate IsNegative(x: int)
{
    x < 0
}

method FindNegativeNumbers(arr: array<int>) returns (negatives: seq<int>)
    requires arr != null
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < |negatives| ==> IsNegative(negatives[i])
    ensures forall i :: 0 <= i < arr.Length && IsNegative(arr[i]) ==> exists k :: 0 <= k < |negatives| && negatives[k] == arr[i]
    ensures multiset(negatives) == multiset([a | a in arr[..] | IsNegative(a)])
{
    negatives := [];
    var i := 0;
    while i < arr.Length
        invariant 0 <= i <= arr.Length
        invariant multiset(negatives) == multiset([a | a in arr[..i] | IsNegative(a)])
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < |negatives| ==> IsNegative(negatives[k])
        invariant forall k :: 0 <= k < i ==> IsNegative(arr[k])
    {
        if IsNegative(arr[i])
        {
            negatives := negatives + [arr[i]];
        }
        i := i + 1;
    }
}
```
